history.summary: $2.19M for a 1,475 sqft '3BR' (listed; SRX gives the 3BR type as 1,679 sqft) on a high floor of Suites @ Kovan, a 16-unit, 5-storey freehold boutique block (TOP ~2010-12) 4 min from Kovan NEL. Most of the block is 366 sqft 1BR shoeboxes. No unit this size has transacted in the URA window: all 9 resale prints since Dec-21 are 1BRs or 807-1,044 sqft 2BRs.
history.rating_rationale: The score of 766 rests on two artifacts. First, yield: the $9,861/mo rent (5.4% gross) is extrapolated from 1BR contracts and capped for oversize; the project's own 2BR rents are $3,300-3,800, and a Kovan 3BR realistically fetches ~$4.5-5.5k, which is ~2.5-3% gross. Second, value: the -13.9% vs the URA median compares against shoebox PSFs. Against age-adjusted D19 same-size peers the discount is only -4.4%, which is noise. The ask of $1,485 psf is ABOVE the project's only large-unit prints ($1,111 psf for 1,044 sqft in Nov-22, $1,349 for 807 sqft in Sep-22). The 8.08% CAGR comes from 9 mostly-shoebox prints, so it is story, not signal. For a 5-7yr investment hold, exit is the problem: a $2.2M 3BR in a 16-unit block with no facilities depth and zero comparable resales has a very thin buyer pool (family buyers at this quantum shop full-facility D19 condos). No realsmart data (page 404). Avoid at this price. It would only be interesting well under ~$1.3k psf, and even then liquidity caps it at Neutral.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Project rental book is 1BRs at $2.2-2.5k and 2BRs at $3.3-3.8k; no 3BR contracts. The model's $9.9k is not credible. Expect ~$4.5-5.5k, i.e. ~2.5-3.0% gross, ~1.5% net.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: No override. The 9-print, 5yr CAGR of 8.08% is size-mix-driven and trailing, with ≈0 forward power. Use the OCR/D19 district prior (~3-4%/yr) at best, discounted for boutique illiquidity on a large quantum.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: Stacks not researched (16 units, not worth a profile). High floor of a 5-storey block; the 3BR type is likely a top-floor/large format.
